name: @islee23520/lfp
description: LazyCodex extension plugin that brings the full OMO feature set into Codex: complete agent roster, category routing, MCP fallback resolver for saved override configurations, art team, and visual specialists.
author: islee23520

interface.displayName: LFP — Full OMO Bridge for Codex
interface.shortDescription: Extends LazyCodex with the complete OMO feature set: all agents, category routing, MCP fallback resolver for saved override configurations, art team, and visual specialists.
interface.longDescription: LFP bridges the gap between LazyCodex (OMO Light edition) and the full OMO feature set. It installs LFP-owned agents (sisyphus, visual specialists, art team), manages primary model overrides on upstream agents, provides category-based model routing guidance, exposes an MCP tool for manual model fallback resolution from saved override configurations, runs interactive TUI setup, performs atomic runtime promotion with rollback, and orchestrates multi-agent workflows.
defaultPrompt: Run UI work with visual QA.
Use visual-looker for Gemini multimodal visual evidence inspection.
Use artistry for art direction, artistry-gen for Computer Use production, artistry-qa for visual inspection.
Use sisyphus for Sisyphus-style implementation loops and independent done-claim verification.

tools.name: model_fallback_resolver
tools.description: MCP tool for manual fallback lookup. Given an agent name and optional error reason (quota, rate-limit, 429, error), returns the effective model from saved override configurations (primary or configured fallback). Never writes anything. Safe to call from any agent on quota/rate/provider failure.

agent.description: Agent name, e.g. explorer, metis, plan, sisyphus, visual-engineering, visual-looker, momus

reason.description: Optional error category that triggers fallback: quota, rate-limit, 429, error, fail
